Feature PRs target `codex/preview`. Production releases target `main` from
`codex/preview` in this repository.

Describe the problem and resulting behavior, then record relevant validation.

For a production release, also record the preview commit and what you checked at
https://codex-preview--hackbarna.netlify.app. Wait for that branch deploy to finish
before merging. Use **Create a merge commit** for the release and keep the preview
branch.
